title: Implement store useBagStore
diff: +export function addLine(lines: BagLine[], item: Item): BagLine[] {
+  return lines.map((entry) => (entry === line ? { ...entry, quantity: entry.quantity + 1 } : entry))
+  addItem: (item) => set((state) => ({ lines: addLine(state.lines, item), lastAddedId: item.id })),
+export const selectCount = (state: BagState): number => state.lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.quantity, 0)
+export const selectTotal = (state: BagState): number => state.lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.item.price * line.quantity, 0)

traceDiagram.title: Items page flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the items page reads the item count and the total of the bag store through `selectCount()` and `selectTotal()`. It also shows what happens when the user clicks Add to bag or Empty the bag, and how each click reaches the bag store through `addItem()` or `clear()`.

traceNodes.label: Keeps the lines of the bag and the last item added
traceNodes.description:
Three paths reach this store:
- When `ItemsPage` renders, [it calls `useBagStore()` with `selectCount()` and `selectTotal()`](code:src/pages/items/ItemsPage.tsx#L5-6), and Zustand runs each selector on the state of this store.
- When a user clicks "Add to bag", [the button calls `addItem()` with the item of its row](code:src/pages/items/ItemsPage.tsx#L21).
- When a user clicks "Empty the bag", [the button runs `clear()`](code:src/pages/items/ItemsPage.tsx#L14).
